name: Poison
desc: Loses 6% max HP at the start of each of its turns.

name: Burn
desc: Loses 4% max HP each turn; ATK x0.85; healing received x0.75.

name: Slow
desc: Time gauge fills at 60% speed. Cancels Haste.

name: Haste
desc: Time gauge fills at 150% speed. Cancels Slow.

name: Sleep
desc: Skips turns until hit or it wears off; then briefly immune.

name: Silence
desc: Cannot use magic or songs. Gadgets and items still work.

name: Regen
desc: Recovers 8% max HP at the start of each of its turns.

name: Stun
desc: Loses its next turn and breaks any charge. Then immune to stun for 2 turns.

name: Marked
desc: Attacks against it gain +20% critical chance; some skills deal bonus damage.

name: Guard
desc: Damage taken x0.5 until its next turn.

name: Cover
desc: Intercepts single-target physical attacks aimed at allies.

name: Challenge
desc: Enemies usually aim single-target attacks at this unit.
